applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
The Portal may display “We cannot provide a verification letter; the information supplied is invalid” when an account-letter or statement request is restricted.

A risk or location review is one possible cause. The message alone does not establish the customer's physical location. Check the actual restriction and customer circumstances; where the customer is outside a restricted location, an ordinary network/session problem can be investigated.

If the failure persists, provide the exact error and account details to support. A support request does not waive a confirmed service restriction. Retrying a download is separate from satisfying a marketplace's review of the resulting document.
